title: MATTER HIERARCHY

lists.name: Chart labels
items: INTERNAL CRYPTO-OPPOSITES (IS ORDINARY MATTER ITSELF SUBDIVIDED INTO SUB-MATTERS?)

notes: MATTER + OTHER + LEVEL + OTHER + ALL → MATTER HIERARCHY. Downward sequences connect PAIRED OPPOSITES → META-OPPOSITES → HYPER-META-OPPOSITES and ENERGY HIERARCHY → ABSTRACT SPACES HIERARCHY → HIERARCHY OF COSMOSES → REALITY HIERARCHY; REALITY HIERARCHY — OTHER → REALITIES HIERARCHY. A curved branch from MATTER HIERARCHY leads through META = (INVERSION) to INTERNAL CRYPTO-OPPOSITES, then downward to HYPO-REAL HIERARCHY.
